problem: The live /wc wave produced overlapping recovery claims for the same stale opportunities. Facultad Digital INTENT recorded a first completed recovery plus a later overlapping recovery claim, and Facultad Digital DISCOVER currently has two recent recovery claims while no RETURN was yet visible at inspection time. Append-only preservation is working, but recovery activation itself can still spend duplicate worker capacity and force later reconciliation.
acceptance: At most one recovery attempt becomes active writer per opportunity generation.
Concurrent losing recovery attempts detect collision without overwriting evidence.
Late returns remain candidate evidence and are reconciled append-only.
title: Arbitrate concurrent recovery claims
mission: Add and canary a repository-host recovery-claim arbitration primitive that preserves append-only recovery evidence while ensuring concurrent stale-recovery attempts for the same opportunity/generation have one active writer and durable loser/collision evidence. Do not erase late attempts or promote any candidate authority.

incident_repair.reason: Two live Facultad recovery lanes exhibited overlapping recovery claims during the current high-parallelism canary.

unblock_value.reason: Single-writer recovery arbitration reduces duplicate worker consumption and makes dependency gates converge with less reconciliation debt.

regression_prevention.reason: The fix must preserve append-only late-return evidence while preventing duplicate active recovery writers, so recovery safety does not regress into overwrite semantics.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Fewer duplicate recoveries means less guide/human reconciliation and more useful durable progress per identical /wc launch.

falsification: Two concurrent eligible recoveries for one opportunity/generation can both become active writers.
A losing recovery attempt can overwrite or delete the winning recovery claim or original attempt evidence.
Late original/recovery returns are discarded instead of preserved as candidate evidence for reconciliation.
The arbitration primitive depends on chat-local state rather than durable repository evidence.
Recovery arbitration changes Current, Human Accepted or Served authority.
dedup_note: The existing live-claim-attempt-receipt proposal targets durable observability of generic claim races. This proposal targets recovery-specific single-active-writer arbitration while preserving append-only late-return semantics; exact fingerprint was absent before pin creation.
